messages:
Priya (Support): Escalation: HorizonDocs pilot can't complete bulk user provisioning via SCIM — about 60% of users in the import are stuck with 400 responses. Pilot customer, renewal call in 11 days. @Hana pls own. :rotating_light:
Hana (CS): Ack. Need repro snippet, tenant id, and quick mitigation. Ravi pls prep comms. Is this a regression or quota?
Marcus (Solutions): Marcus here 1: SCIM failures often come from malformed user attributes or rate throttling. Priya paste sample response and tenant.
Priya (Support): Logs:
```
2027-02-10T09:02:11Z scim POST /Users tenant=horizon-42 resp=400 body="invalid_schema: missing 'userName' for 243 rows"
2027-02-10T09:02:12Z scim POST /Users tenant=horizon-42 resp=429 body="rate_limit_exceeded" attempts=1
```
Repro: CSV import via admin UI -> certain rows fail with 400, others hit 429 on retry. Ticket 96822.
Hana (CS): Ok, two issues: bad rows and transient throttling. Quick comms plan: 1) immediate ack + clear next steps 2) provide a sanitized CSV template + offer to run import for them 3) request short quota bump while we support 4) schedule a 30m enablement to review their identity mapping. Owner=Ravi, tech lead=Marcus. Renewal_flag=true until import completes.
Ravi (Account): I'll own comms. Drafting note to offer manual import and mapping help. Also offering a short window for a throughput bump.
Marcus (Solutions): Tech plan: A) run a lightweight validator that scans CSV and flags missing required SCIM attributes (I can prepare and share within 30m) B) request infra temporary rate bump for tenant horizon-42 for 2h C) add guidance to importer UI to fail fast on invalid rows. I'll open PR and page infra.
infra-bot: Runbook: SCIM bulk import errors -> https://redwood.runbooks/scim-bulk-import (link)
Priya (Support): I've attached a failed-rows sample to the ticket and re-run logs. Some of the failing rows are missing userName; some have malformed emails. Also noted spike in API calls from their sync tool earlier this morning.
Ravi (Account): Sent initial comms at 09:25: "Hi Horizon team 99we saw errors in your bulk import. Short-term we can run the import for you and share a validator to clean the CSV. We'll also request a temporary throughput increase while we assist. Can we schedule a 30m screenshare?" Waiting reply.
Marcus (Solutions): Infra acknowledged the page and approved a +1.5x SCIM throughput bump for 2h while we assist. I'll post the validator script in the ticket and provide instructions to re-upload.
Priya (Support): Update 09:40 99ran validator against customer's file locally: it flagged 243 missing userName rows and 18 malformed emails. After fixing and re-uploading in <=200-row batches, import completed at 10:10 with 100% success.
Ravi (Account): Customer accepted the manual assist and screenshare at 10:00. They appreciated the validator and asked for clearer mapping docs for future imports. Capturing feedback.
Hana (CS): Closing loop: immediate risk mitigated, renewal risk downgraded. Action items: Marcus -> land validator as a small tool in docs + PR to improve importer UX (fail-fast for required fields); Priya -> attach a how-to for CSV cleaning to ticket; Ravi -> send follow-up summary and offer a 1-week check-in. I'll own the postmortem / docs update. ETA 3 business days. Thanks all. :white_check_mark:
